narrative: Material PL1__MC9C6CAA exhibits moderately variable daily demand (mean=2210 units/wd, CV=0.20) with highly variable lead times (mean=1.41 wd, CV=0.65). Three low-demand outlier days were winsorised to preserve distributional integrity. An (r,Q) continuous-review policy with ROP=10799 and OQ=8086 is recommended; the elevated safety stock of 5666 units is driven primarily by lead-time variability, providing adequate buffer for the 95% service level target within storage capacity constraints.

research_insights.selection_rationale: The material has continuous, non-intermittent demand (non-zero fraction = 100%) with moderate variability (CV=0.20), making a classic continuous-review (r,Q) policy well-suited. EOQ minimises total ordering + holding cost at the given unit cost and ordering expense. The fixed MOQ of 127 is well below the EOQ of 8,086, so the MOQ constraint does not distort the economic optimum.
research_insights.boundary_risk: The combined SS+OQ position of 13752 units sits just within the storage capacity of 13956 units (headroom: 204 units). Any upward revision of safety stock — e.g. if service-level targets are raised to 97.5%+ — risks breaching capacity and would require either a storage expansion or an OQ reduction that increases ordering frequency.
